name: Harmonic integrals and the vanishing theorem (Kodaira)
summary: Hodge theory (harmonic forms) is applied to compact Kahler manifolds to prove vanishing theorems and characterise projective varieties.

name: Nash equilibrium
summary: Equilibria of non-cooperative games were shown to exist via fixed-point arguments.

name: Cobordism: homotopy theory computes manifold invariants
summary: Manifolds up to cobordism are classified by homotopy groups of Thom spaces, turning geometric questions into computations in stable homotopy theory.

name: Serre: spectral sequences and homotopy groups
summary: Leray's spectral sequence applied to fibrations gave homotopy results for spheres.

name: Tate's thesis and adelic harmonic analysis
summary: Fourier analysis on idele groups gave a new proof of functional equations for Hecke L-functions.

name: Kleene theorem on regular events
summary: Finite automata and regular events were shown equivalent.

name: Dynamic programming
summary: Principle of optimality recast multi-stage decisions as recursion.

name: Calderon-Zygmund singular integrals enter PDE
summary: Singular integral operators from harmonic analysis give L^p estimates and uniqueness results for elliptic and parabolic equations.

name: Fourier analysis for density problems (Roth)
summary: A circle-method style Fourier argument with a density-increment iteration shows dense integer sets contain three-term progressions.

name: MCMC revival of Bayesian statistics
summary: Metropolis-type samplers, via Gibbs sampling, make posterior computation feasible.
